tagline: Conversation outline: Use the conversation outline along the left edge of Genie One conversations to jump between your messages.
what_it_does: Conversation outline: Use the conversation outline along the left edge of Genie One conversations to jump between your messages. Hover over a tick in the outline to preview a message and the start of its response. Upload skills (Public Preview): You can now click Upload skills to upload your existing skill files and folders to your skills folder in the workspace.
why_it_matters: For IT and security teams, see Administer the Genie mobile app for configuration guidance, network security requirements, authentication setup, and Mobile Device Management (MDM) deployment.
